notes.title: Playtest Release
notes.notes:
We would like to briefly inform you about the development of the Eden: Project New Earth playtest. Our plan is that we will start the official Play Test at the end of quarter 1 at the beginning of quarter 2 2024. YouTubers and streamers have the opportunity to apply for early access to us on the Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/3AGZHaxPjT
or 
via email: info@limesgames.de.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839200/8fbdbcbd977c6078ef9f08656fbb2f5e868c0c99.png[/img]


If interested, we will also provide them with information, pictures and video material and can actively support us to become better known worldwide. All other Playtesters can look forward to a test that shows the basic principles of the game and the beginnings of multiplayer. In the first test period, animals will not yet be tamed or bred. For now, animals only serve as enemies and sources of meat. The character will be playable and levelable up to level 30, further levels and more content will be added in the course of the playtest.
